properties.level_of_theory: B3LYP/def2SVP + EmpiricalDispersion(GD3BJ), Gaussian 16, gas phase, charge 0, singlet
properties.note: pre-reaction pi-complex of two cyclopentadienes (parallel-displaced stack, interplanar 3.32 A, forming contacts C2...C12 3.45 A / C4...C13 3.37 A); 60 real modes incl. six intermolecular modes 34-97 cm-1; binding -4.66 kcal/mol vs 2 separated Cp. IRC reactant-side endpoint relaxes onto this same minimum (-387.964427881 Ha, ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0015/reactant_opt/reactant_opt.log).

endo saddle, exactly one imaginary frequency; strongly asynchronous (forming distances C2...C12 2.839 A, C4...C13 1.970 A; imaginary mode dominated by the C4...C13 stretch with ~1/5 of that amplitude on the C2...C12 pair). Endo registry confirmed (C=C midpoint separation 2.91 A). IRC (LQA, ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0015/irc/irc.log, 49 points, both directions converged) connects it to the RC complex on one side and to the tricyclic endo adduct on the other.

endo-dicyclopentadiene (tricyclo[5.2.1.0^2,6]deca-3,8-diene); endo confirmed on the optimised geometry (both C=C on the same side, midpoint separation 3.18 A); -24.45 kcal/mol vs 2 separated Cp. The IRC product-side endpoint closes both new bonds (1.563/1.558 A) with the new C1=C5 1.342 A, i.e. the same tricyclic adduct.
